observations: Actual reset/step RGB in x,y,channel order, parsed into visible x,y,heading,red-X. Public controllers receive only these, issued actions, reward. No seed, hidden route, origin, goal, native state or info.
semantics: Failure occurs at unsafe destination. Next action ignored, consumes one step, returns to origin preserving heading. Within-episode return does not clear full memory. Episode reset clears all memory. Goal on action128 counts; upstream time limit is terminated not truncated.
planner: Shortest unit-cost primitive-action path through known safe (x,y,heading) states to a first unknown-cell forward entry. Ties by final-entry compass priority then fixed BFS action order and coordinates. This orientation-aware clarification precedes all qualification outcomes.
window_definition: Last W transitions with W+1 endpoint observations, actions and rewards only. Rebuild maps and planner each decision; no retained map, route, frontier, cursor, origin or history outside window. Current frame always available.
erase_definition: Erase older map on failure before incorporating that failure transition, preserving the currently observed unsafe destination and previously visible safe cell.
reference: Evaluator-only known safe cells and goal, shortest primitive-action path, isolated from public policy input. Repeated four orders for paired coverage, not four independent results.
continue: All17criteria and full artifact/native replay verification must pass. Passing admits model research; it is not learned-model superiority or a novelty result.
stop: Any performance criterion failure closes this qualification recipe. Do not change windows, budgets, cases, cues, thresholds, task or order weights after outcomes. Adapter failure retained separately as engineering failure; no case replacement.
metrics: wholeepisode runtime including resets, parser, planning, updates, memory instrumentation and storage
runtime_limitations: Shared-host instrumented CPU timings; not deployment speed, peak RSS, or equal-compute learned-model result. Serialized logical state and Python recursive retained-object estimate differ from process memory.

engineering_preflight.scope: reference-only navigation with one forced fall/ignored action return per seed; no public-controller qualification outcomes

evaluation_order: layout index, compass order, then full,last16,last32,erase_on_failure,reference; same seeded layout identity checked across20 combinations
seed_derivation: First4 SHA256bytes little endian of openjev/mystery-path-qualification-v1/layout/{index}; allocated once, no regeneration
independence: 64generatedlayoutseeds; four orders correlated repeats; deduplicate layout hashes and report actual distinct count if repeats. No seed replacement.
